headline: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart for $17 Billion in Major Delivery Deal
summary: DoorDash has agreed to buy Instacart for $17 billion. The transaction merges the largest restaurant delivery service in the United States with its top online grocery platform.
why: DoorDash and Instacart are major U.S. technology companies specializing in last-mile delivery services for restaurants and supermarkets.

impacts.name: Maplebear Inc.
impacts.why: Acquisition deals typically offer target companies a premium over market price.

why_moved: The $17 billion consolidation alters market dynamics across food and grocery delivery sectors in North America.
